jobs.description:
Job Family

IT - Development

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

The Senior Director of Software Engineering provides leadership in the development of new web and cloud technologies to support an agile digital business. Define enterprise web and cloud strategies, grow capabilities, and develop the team by providing technology vision and leadership, career development, and mentoring in design, framework and platform decisions. Define and communicate delivery plans, manage team budgets, and partner with leaders in key business and IT groups to deliver value through efficient use of development resources.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Provide technical guidance and leadership to the development teams to deliver quality solutions utilized by multiple lines of business. Continue to drive the team toward delivery of the best end to end design solutions for the enterprise.
Interact with executive management to develop strategic direction for the department and functional areas.
Partner with executive leadership and stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Provide clear direction by translating strategic priorities and goals into defined tactical action plans and milestones. Work with cross functional leaders to understand and influence business strategy, set priorities, and define technology goals.
Act as a strategist and champion for enterprise architecture and design principles.
Lead white board discussions and presentations with key stakeholders, executive leadership, and enterprise architecture team.
Identify opportunities to utilize third-party software development frameworks, open source libraries, and APIs in agile, and speed to market focused development for business partners.
Ensure high quality service is achieved by providing oversight, monitoring key performance indicators, internal controls, and keeping abreast of market events and industry changes. Bring a passion to stay on top of technical trends, experiment with new technologies, and participate in internal and external technology communities.
Act quickly and appropriately to solve problems, bring clarity, and minimize the impact of unforeseen circumstances.
Drive a culture of change and innovation which constructively challenges the status quo and leads to prudent experimentation. Have a growth mindset with the ability to adopt new practices and spearhead adoption.
Oversee the quality, delivery, performance, cost, and scope for cloud and web development initiatives.
Develop staff through coaching, provide timely performance feedback and assessments and establish performance and development plans. Mentor current and future leaders, ensuring a constantly rising bar in technical excellence and professional growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, math, engineering, or other technical field, or equivalent experience
Twelve years of experience with database design techniques/philosophies, modern distributed applications, and microservices
Ten years of experience in delivery of large-scale design projects involving interaction with a broad spectrum of enterprise operational functions
Eight years of experience managing a diverse team and leading cross-functional teams.
Strong background in the execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deliver, and accomplishments in architecture and strategy.
Experience managing vendor relationships, including product/service evaluation, contract negotiations, and on-going relationship management
Familiarity with modern UI development frameworks (e.g. Angular, React, Vue.js) and web technologies (e.g. HTTP, HTML, JS, CSS)
Results oriented with a strong customer focus
Strong communication skills to delivery highly relevant and effective information to the Board, executives, and employees.
Ability to synthesize ambiguous and complex information in a way the leads to substantive actionable outcomes.
Proactive mindset to drive change, question assumptions and push for innovation solutions.
Ability to work as part of a team and independently
Analytical and problem-solving skills
Technical communication skills and the ability to present information to all levels of the organization
Problem-solving and technical communication skills
Ability to work in a highly matrixed environment and identify, define, and resolve organizational issues
Creative analytical thinker
Ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree
Experience with advanced analytics and machine learning concepts and technology implementations
Understanding of big data and real time data processing architecture and ecosystems
Experience with solution architecture and implementation
Technology or platform certifications (e.g. AWS, Microsoft)
Knowledge of the financial services industry

Working Conditions

Hybrid Office Environment
Work outside of normal business hours may be required
Frequent Travel 25 to 50%

Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

Compensation

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $215,000 - $260,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including
qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

Chief Technology Officer

Acru Inc. · Seed-stage · San Francisco / remote-friendly · Founding technical leader

About Acru
Acru is building a consumer loyalty platform where rewards are real, dollar-stable value the customer actually owns — issued by the brand, backed 1:1 by USDC, and portable across a network of brands. Instead of points that expire and reset to zero, consumers earn stable-value rewards they can hold, spend across participating brands, or cash out to their bank. Merchants get their own branded currency and keep the customer relationship and the data — not a bank's rebate. We are post-patent-filing, raising a seed round, and moving from a controlled multi-merchant pilot into full platform build.
The role
You will be the founding CTO—the technical co-founder alongside others. You own every architectural decision: the issuance-and-settlement engine, custody and security of the USDC reserve, money movement enforced in code, the multi-tenant merchant architecture, and a phased AI roadmap. You will make every build-vs-buy call, hire and lead a small senior team, and stand in investor technical diligence alongside the CEO. This is the seat that decides the architecture, not the seat that executes someone else's.
The CEO has deep loyalty-domain experience (MyPoints, $0–$64M) and stays actively involved in token-economics decisions; you bring the implementation depth. Both of you are in the room for technical diligence.
What you'll own in Year 1
●  Reward issuance & settlement:
deterministic conversion of purchases into stable-value USDC rewards, settling in about two seconds on Base.
●  Custody & reserve security:
hot/cold wallet architecture, key management (KMS/HSM), signing policy, incident response. A key compromise is existential, not a bug.
●  Money movement in code:
partner-originated ACH (never in-house Nacha origination), strict idempotency, an async return-state machine, return-code handling, and the fraud controls at the one place where the reserve, the funding model, and live payouts meet.
●  Multi-tenant, cross-brand architecture:
a pluggable merchant-connector model and a real double-entry ledger from day one, scaling toward a network of brands with a shared, portable balance.
●  Consumer wallet:
embedded, email login, dollar-denominated, no seed phrase — crypto made invisible to the consumer.
●  Phased AI:
an agent-legibility layer that exposes a consumer's real dollar balance to external commerce agents, plus reward-graph, fraud/sybil, personalization, and churn models trained on real transaction data.

Our stack
●  USDC on Base (an Ethereum L2 — sub-cent transfers are what make sub-dollar rewards economic).
●  Embedded wallets (Privy, now part of Stripe, or Coinbase Embedded Wallets).
●  A proprietary ERC-20 extension (patent pending) for role-based issuance and lifecycle controls.
● Partner ODFI / payments platform for ACH; Plaid for account verification.
● REST / GraphQL APIs for POS, e-commerce, and CRM integration.

What we're looking for
● Production ML and applied data engineering at scale — fraud detection, real-time inference, a recommendation/reward graph.
● EVM smart-contract development — Solidity, ERC-20 extensions, upgradeable proxy patterns.
● Production experience on an Ethereum L2 (ideally Base) with USDC settlement and reserve custody, and with partner-originated ACH, including return handling and idempotency.
●  A track record of building and leading small, high-output engineering teams from zero.
● Consumer product sensibility — you are shipping consumer-facing products, not just infrastructure.
● Comfort defending the architecture in investor technical diligence.

Compensation
Market-rate cash salary plus meaningful founding equity. And additional benefits. Hybrid.
Regulatory context (so you can gauge fit)
We operate under the GENIUS Act—the U.S. stablecoin law enacted in July 2025—with implementing rules now being finalized and the framework taking effect in January 2027. Rewards are commerce-earned, stable-value, and USDC-backed — never yield-bearing. If you have built compliant money movement, you will recognize the shape of the problem.
How to apply
Email chazb@acru.life with a short note and anything that shows how you think about custody, ledgers, or money movement. Skip the generic cover letter — we would rather see how you reason.

jobs.description:
About Greystar

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

Job Description Summary

The Director, Web Platform Engineering leads Greystar's web platform team and owns technical direction for greystar.com and the broader Sitecore-based web ecosystem, a multi-year platform commitment whose primary job is turning visitors into leases, and happy residents! You partner

with the product lead, who owns the roadmap and business direction, as a technical peer, a genuine technical counterpart to product on where the platform goes next.

This is a leader-doer role for a small but mighty strong team. You’ll bring deep, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI, while staying solutions-focused rather than platform-focused. Sitecore is the backbone of how we deliver, not the default answer to every problem. You’ll bring that same flexibility in how the platform approaches search and discovery, and build culture of shared documentation and knowledge so expertise lives with the team rather than any one person. You'll also invest directly in developing the engineers on your team and work across our global organization.

You'll set technical direction, stay hands-on, and hold yourself and the team to a standard of collaborative decision-making. As part of the Data, Digital, and AI (D2AI) organization, you'll coordinate with fellow D2AI teams (data platform, CI, AI engineering) on how the web platform connects to broader data and AI capabilities.

Job Description

What You Will Do

Technical Direction & Product Partnership

Own technical direction for the web platform, partnering with the product lead as a peer to shape priorities and sequencing together.
Translate business priorities (leads and leases, campaign enablement, SEO,

personalization and experimentation) into technical strategy.

Represent the web platform in enterprise technology planning, aligning direction with the rest of D2AI and broader Greystar priorities.

Lead From the Front

Stay hands-on: contribute directly and daily to architecture, code review, and development across the platform.
Set the technical example for the team, modeling the standard of work and collaborative decision-making you expect from them.

Web Platform Architecture & Engineering

Bring deep, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI, Vercel, and any other evolving web-based technologies across Greystar’s digital properties, with greystar.com as the flagship.
Own architectural decisions for personalization, experimentation, and content delivery on the platform.
Guide the team's ongoing development, staying current on the platform's roadmap and capabilities as Greystar's committed CMS.
Guide architecture and strategy for site search and discovery, ensuring relevance and performance keep pace with business goals.
Partner with the marketing team on content management and operations needs as they evolve.
Coordinate with D2AI's data platform and CI teams on how the web platform consumes and exchanges data (Cosmos DB, Salesforce, Databricks), partnering on integration points without owning that broader architecture.

AI-Forward Engineering Practices

Use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) in your own day-today work, modeling high-leverage, AI-forward practices for the team.
Champion automated testing practices, unit tests, visual regression tests, or similar, as AIaccelerated development increases the pace and volume of change.
Evaluate and adopt AI-enabled tooling for content operations, personalization, and testing.
Coach the team on effective, responsible use of AI in their own engineering workflows.

People Leadership, Mentorship & Career Management

Lead, coach, and grow the existing team, providing hands-on technical guidance and architectural thinking.
Own performance management, career development, and growth planning for each team member; mentorship and career growth are core expectations of this role.
Hire selectively to complement the team's existing strengths as the roadmap requires.

Platform Documentation & Knowledge Distribution

Document architecture, integrations, and operational knowledge so it lives with the team, not any single person.
Cross-train the team and distribute access and ownership so no one, including you, becomes the only person who can operate a given part of the platform.

Production Support & Operations

Own break-fix resolution and production support (L2/L3) for the web platform, in-house, ensuring issues are resolved within SLA.
Maintain release processes, deployment standards, and on-call practices for the team.

How You Operate

Strong opinions, weakly held: you can pivot fast when the situation calls for it, no sacred cows, no attachment to a decision just because you made it.
You're comfortable moving forward when strategy is still taking shape, and you don't need every answer settled to make progress.
You look for pragmatic, collaborative paths forward, the phased rollout or the wellscoped experiment, rather than forcing all-or-nothing choices.
You document and share knowledge as second nature, and you take real satisfaction in building up the people around you.
You see the product lead as a genuine partner in shaping the platform's direction.

What You Bring

Web Platform Engineering Excellence

10+ years of web platform or CMS engineering experience, with deep, current, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI and headless implementations. This is not a role for someone who has moved fully away from the keyboard.
Strong hands-on background in modern headless frontend architecture and Vercel or similar deployment platforms.
Deep experience with search platforms (Coveo, Algolia, Elasticsearch, or similar) is a must. Coveo experience specifically is valued.
Proficient with Git and modern CI/CD practices; experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

Leadership & Communication

5+ years leading engineering teams, with a genuine, demonstrable track record of mentoring engineers and helping them grow their careers.
Experience partnering with a product lead or product manager who owns roadmap direction, in a peer relationship rather than a reporting one.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to represent the platform to senior technology and business leadership.

AI & Modern Tooling

Deep, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot, not just awareness of them.
Genuine enthusiasm for using AI to accelerate engineering work, with real examples of how you've applied it.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with marketing teams on content management platforms and operations.
Experience on a conversion-focused digital platform (lead generation or e-commerce, not just content/brand).
Experience operating a platform across multiple regions (this platform also supports Greystar's European operations).
Datadog or equivalent monitoring/observability expertise.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent

experience.

Tools & Technologies

Sitecore AI, Next.js/React (App Router), Vercel, Coveo, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Git, LaunchDarkly, Datadog, Figma, Linear, AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot)

jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and are responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

May assist in the building out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency

Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.

Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility of operations and maintenance.

Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day-to-day tasks

Physical Requirements

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodation:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Essential Requirements

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.

About The Team

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. jobs.title: Director Datacenter Security Systems, AWS Infra. Security
jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Datacenter Security Systems leads the global implementation of security controls within AWS datacenters. From creation through datacenter retirement, this role is accountable for delivering innovative security controls that meet the business needs for scale and speed. This role coordinates across design, construction, networking, and partner software teams to deliver physical and logical controls through software and process innovation, and is accountable for both building innovative solutions and operating them at fleet scale.

Infrastructure Security is looking for an experienced Director of Software Development to transform how we create and maintain datacenter security controls across Amazon. You will operate Tier-1 services foundational to AWS datacenter operations and define the approach for deploying security at the speed of modular builds while continuously raising the security bar across all of AWS.

This opportunity is multi-disciplinary, requiring depth of knowledge and experience in security solutions, software development, building design, product management, AWS services, and cost control. It requires a leader who can deliver security solutions within the context of business outcomes and drive iterative improvement in an environment where both the threat landscape and the pace of construction are changing rapidly.

You will draw from deep and broad technical expertise to guide software engineers, principal engineers, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence. You will apply AI and machine learning to transform how your systems operate: from computer vision that performs real-time authorization decisions, to automated triage and anomaly detection, to intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort. This role has substantial visibility with senior executives and is built for a leader who thrives on pace, ambiguity, and building high-performing teams from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end design, delivery, and operation of datacenter security systems globally, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter detection, and the software platforms that manage them
Transform cameras into active assurance mechanisms through computer vision that performs real-time physical authorization linked to work order systems, reducing reliance on manual observation for access verification
Deliver security infrastructure that ships at modular build speed: persistent hardware from construction through operations, standardized security kits, and zero-touch provisioning that eliminates per-site engineering effort
Build and operate a Tier-1 service owning the complete lifecycle of every networked security IoT device globally: onboarding, firmware management, credential rotation, health monitoring, and performance telemetry
Drive security economics that deliver equivalent or better outcomes at lower cost per site as the fleet scales
Define and deliver AI-driven capabilities including computer vision for real-time authorization, automated triage and anomaly detection, generative AI for development acceleration, and intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort
Lead and scale a high-performing engineering organization spanning software development, systems engineering, hardware engineering, and program management

A day in the life

This role spends most days working hand in hand with datacenter operations and datacenter engineering teams. You will advocate for logical security controls across AWS service teams to meet the demands of a modular datacenter build plan, ensuring that every layer of the defense-in-depth continuum is instrumented, measured, and delivering against the security bar at the speed the business requires.

About The Team

The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience
10+ years developing mission-critical system software, with 5+ years driving long-term engineering and product decisions at senior leadership level
Track record of delivering innovative cloud-based applications and services at scale
Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain an inclusive, high-performing organization of 100+ engineers
Experience scaling diverse, highly dynamic, and fast-growing technical and product teams across multiple geographies

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years managing and building software with very high availability and operational excellence requirements
Deep understanding of information security, privacy frameworks, and compliance requirements
Ability to effectively coordinate between technical teams and business stakeholders
Strong ability to build alignment to your teams' vision across diverse business leaders
Ability to drive enterprise-scale changes to existing systems
Effective written and oral communication with multiple levels of leadership involving both business and technical sides of the organization

jobs.title: Senior Manager, High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) spans 120 Availability Zones within 38 geographic Regions around the world, with announced plans for 10 more Availability Zones and three more Regions — making AWS the most extensive global cloud infrastructure provider and one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies ever. Amazon's AWS Data Centers (DC) are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry-leading examples of mission-critical facilities.

Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost-effective DC facilities. We are responsible for achieving world-class uptime for our customers and developing a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet AWS's growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs.

As an Engineering Manager at AWS, you will have the opportunity to impact changes in our current design and establish design procedures and protocols for future systems. AWS Engineering is responsible for the design of all electrical and mechanical systems within all Amazon DCs worldwide. The team works directly with operations, security teams, field engineering, and construction management to implement designs that are functional, practical, and innovative.

The team is seeking a Senior High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering Manager with demonstrated expertise in the design, analysis, and deployment of high-voltage direct current distribution systems, with specific emphasis on 800VDC bus architectures or comparable voltage classes (e.g., ±400V, 600VDC, 1500VDC) in industrial, utility, transportation, renewable energy, or large-scale power infrastructure applications.

This is a highly specialized, foundational engineering role on a newly formed team chartered to design and develop a next-generation, facility-scale High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) power architecture purpose-built for Generative AI compute loads. This is a greenfield, industry-defining effort — reference designs at this scale and application do not broadly exist in the data center industry. As such, we are seeking engineers with deep domain expertise in high-power HVDC and power conversion systems who bring the intellectual foundation and engineering rigor to translate that expertise into a novel data center context. Direct data center experience is welcomed but is not a prerequisite for this role

You will be responsible for delivery of projects, applying design quality controls, and providing technical guidance to team members. As a subject matter expert, you will be responsible for the design of prototypical DC facilities, localization of conceptual innovations, solving large-scale implementation issues, and building strong relationships with the regional industry. This role represents a rare opportunity to define a new class of data center power infrastructure from the ground up. The successful candidate will not be expected to know all the answers on day one — they will be expected to have the engineering depth, intellectual rigor, and collaborative mindset to help build them.

Anticipated travel: up to 25%

Key job responsibilities

Conceive, initiate, and lead projects with widespread impact on infrastructure design, innovation, and implementation

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

Overview:

The Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Platform Engineering will own, end to end, a centralized Power BI monitoring and reporting platform for the Data Governance, Informatics, and Analytics teams within the Enterprise Data Strategy department. This platform is critical for having visibility into Inovalon's data upstream, serving as a tool for data quality improvement, auditing, and data rights management. This leader will be accountable for the full solution, from backend data architecture, pipelines, and infrastructure through to the reports and DAX models stakeholders ultimately use. They will also build and manage a team to deliver it. While day-to-day focus will be on backend platform ownership and team leadership, this person should be hands-on capable across the full stack, stepping in wherever needed to keep delivery moving.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Architecture: Define the data architecture and schemas underpinning the platform, ensuring the structure supports governance, analytics, and informatics reporting needs across multiple business-critical systems
Backend Platform Ownership: Design, build, and maintain ingestion pipelines and integrations connecting the platform to underlying source systems, ensuring data is accurate, timely, audit-ready, and structured to drive Power BI reporting.
Hands-On Flexibility: Step in to develop or troubleshoot Power BI reports and data models as needed to support the team, unblock delivery, or cover gaps.
Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, manage, and mentor a data operations team of engineers; set engineering standards and oversee architecture decisions across the team.
End-to-End Accountability: Own the platform's success from data architecture through to final report, ensuring pipelines, data models, and Power BI work together seamlessly to meet stakeholder needs.
Data Security & Sensitivity: Ensure the platform handles highly sensitive data appropriately throughout the full data lifecycle, in line with company policy and regulatory requirements.
Infrastructure & Scalability: Own the infrastructure supporting the platform (performance, capacity, and environment security), ensuring it scales reliably as data volume and stakeholder usage grow.
Stakeholder Partnership: Work directly with Data Governance, Informatics, and Analytics leads to understand monitoring, KPI, and audit-readiness requirements, and translate them into backend data models and pipeline design.
Engineering Standards: Lead the team in writing high-quality, testable code using a test-first approach where possible, and ensure all work meets an agreed "Definition of Done."
Quality, Testing & Defect Resolution: Oversee creation of automated unit, system, and acceptance tests for data pipelines and services; lead design and code reviews; manage integration, testing, and deployment tasks; and ensure timely resolution of data and pipeline defects.
Agile Delivery: Drive end-of-iteration demos, retrospectives, and continuous team improvement; manage work through Agile tools (e.g., JIRA or similar) and participate in change management as scope evolves.
Documentation: Ensure documentation is written and maintained describing data architecture, pipeline logic, coding standards, testing, and changes.
Maintain compliance with lnovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.
Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within lnovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.
Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by lnovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.
Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function.
We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such.

Experience:

10+ Years of data architecture and engineering experience required

Skills and Abilities:

Proven track record building, leading, and growing high-performing engineering teams within an Agile development environment for 5+ years, with the ability to operate as both a hands-on individual contributor and a people manager.
Proven experience building and scaling large backend data platforms and pipelines that support BI/reporting layers.
Experience working with healthcare data specifically (e.g., claims, clinical/EHR, payer/provider data) strongly preferred; experience in another highly regulated industries considered.
Demonstrated ability to define data architecture and schemas, not just implement against them.
Strong proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Java, Python, or similar) and data pipeline/ETL tools.
Experience with AWS data services and cloud-based data storage solutions.
Working proficiency in Power BI and DAX — strong enough to build, review, or troubleshoot reports.
Experience with modern DevOps/Agile practices (CI/CD, Git, JIRA or similar).
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience partnering directly with non-technical business leaders.

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) in computer science, software engineering, information technology required
Master’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (M.A./M.S.) preferred

Licenses and Certifications:

CRISC certification Preferred
Lean Six Sigma certification Preferred

Inovalon Offers a Competitive Salary And Benefits Package

In addition to the base compensation, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. That’s why Inovalon offers a valuable benefits package with a wide range of choices to meet associate needs, which may include health insurance, life insurance, company-paid disability, 401k, 18+ days of paid time off, and more.

Base Compensation Range

$170,000—$220,000 USD

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?

We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.

Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.

Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.

Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.

Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.

Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.

Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.

Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.

Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.

Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About The Team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

Description

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems

Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes

Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines

Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design

Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes

Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?

We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.

Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.

Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.

Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.

Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.

Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.

Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.

Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.

Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.

Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About The Team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

jobs.title: Sr. PLM and CAD Manager, Amazon Leo Enterprise Engineering & Technology
jobs.description:
Description

Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Development Manager to lead the strategy, development, and operational excellence of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Fleet Management, and ServiceNow platforms. This role is responsible for managing a team of engineers and administrators who build, integrate, and maintain mission-critical enterprise systems that support product design, engineering workflows, and IT service management across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong people leadership and a track record of delivering scalable, reliable enterprise solutions at scale.

Key job responsibilities

PLM Platform Ownership — Lead the architecture, development, and support of PLM systems (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter or equivalent), ensuring seamless integration with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain workflows

CAD Infrastructure Management — Oversee the deployment, licensing, performance, and integration of CAD tools (e.g., Mentor, NX) across the enterprise, including high-performance computing environments and visualization solutions

Team Leadership — Recruit, develop, and manage a high-performing team of systems development engineers, platform administrators, and technical program managers

Strategic Roadmap — Define and execute a multi-year technology roadmap for PLM, CAD, Fleet Management, and ServiceNow platforms aligned with business objectives and organizational growth

jobs.title: Sr Release Manager, Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a highly technical Design Portfolio Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Design portfolio Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Partner with Electrical Engineers on power distribution design, generator sizing, UPS configurations, switchgear specifications, and high-voltage systems
Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads
Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

Program Execution

Track and report on design change metrics including approval timelines, cost avoidance, implementation status, and technical quality
Maintain design change databases and dashboards for cross-functional visibility
Support BOD release planning and coordination to minimize redesign impacts
Participate in weekly leadership reviews presenting program status, key decisions, and technical recommendations

About The Team

The Global Design Standards and Change Management (GDSCM) organization within Data Center Engineering is responsible for establishing and maintaining design standards across the global data center portfolio. Our team manages three mission-critical programs:

Basis of Design (BOD) Establishes and governs the foundational technical standards for all global data center designs, ensuring consistency and quality across the portfolio.

Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) Manages design change requests across 300+ in-flight projects.

360 Equipment Qualification Program (360 EQP) Qualifies equipment and technologies for deployment across the global portfolio, evaluating emerging solutions and driving standardization of critical systems.

Together, these programs deliver capacity across the AMER, APAC, and EMEA regions.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

jobs.title: Senior Manager, 5G RAN – Core Systems Software Architecture
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver high-speed, low-latency broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the design, development, and lab integration of real-time communications software enabling robust, standards-compliant connectivity between gNodeB platforms and Multi-Operator Core Network (MOCN) environments.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP control-plane and data-plane protocols, extensive experience with NGC and NGU interfaces, and the ability to architect, partition, and guide the implementation of complex software systems. Equally important, this leader will build, develop, and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and career growth.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years experience developing interfaces to 5G Core networks, a strong understanding of RRC signaling, Multi-PLMN broadcast configuration, and PLMN operations, as well as practical expertise with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and physical integration of RAN and transport systems in a lab environment. This Senior Manager will play a critical leadership role in hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers across multiple levels while driving execution of complex technical programs.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect and design the full software stack enabling real-time control-plane and data-plane communication between gNodeB and MOCN environments in support of Amazon Leo's satellite-terrestrial integration objectives.
Define software partitioning, module boundaries, and interface specifications for NGC, NGU, RRC, and Multi-PLMN broadcast components.
Lead development of 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity.
Oversee integration of transport technologies, including MPLS and segment routing, into the RAN–Core connectivity architecture.
Drive troubleshooting and performance optimization across NGC, NGU, and RRC layers.
Author technical specifications, architecture documents, and interface control documents (ICDs) for internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving MOCN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned with Amazon Leo's roadmap.

Lab Integration & Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing

Lead lab activities including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test framework development, physical interface validation, and system-level integration testing.
Develop and validate HIL test frameworks ensuring accurate modeling of physical interfaces, fronthaul/backhaul connectivity, and multi-operator core interactions.
Oversee lab infrastructure planning, equipment procurement, and test environment configuration to support rapid prototyping and validation cycles.
Drive lab-based integration of RAN, transport, and core network components, ensuring end-to-end system alignment and standards compliance.
Collaborate with RF, RAN, and Core engineering teams in the lab to validate satellite-terrestrial network interoperability.

Team Building & People Development

Build and scale a high-performing software engineering team through strategic hiring, including conducting phone screens, on-site interviews, and bar raiser activities.
Develop individual growth plans for each engineer, identifying technical and leadership development opportunities aligned with career aspirations.
Mentor engineers at all levels, providing regular coaching on technical depth, system design thinking, and Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Foster a culture of continuous learning through technical brown bags, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Identify and develop future technical leaders within the team, creating pathways for promotion and increased scope.
Conduct regular 1:1s focused on career development, skill gap analysis, and stretch assignments that accelerate engineer growth.
Create an inclusive team environment that encourages innovation, calculated risk-taking, and learning from failure.
Drive organizational health metrics including retention, engagement, and internal mobility.

Program Execution & Amazon Leadership

Own the technical roadmap and execution plan, driving delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
Operate with a bias for action while maintaining the highest bar for quality and safety in satellite communications systems.
Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, design documents) to senior leadership.
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
Demonstrate Ownership by treating the team's mission as your own, and Earn Trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of people management, managing engineers experience
10+ years of experience developing software for 4G/5G Core interfaces, RAN–Core integration, or cellular protocol stacks.
Deep expertise in 3GPP NGC (control plane) and NGU (user plane) protocols.
Strong understanding of RRC signaling, RAN procedures, and Multi-PLMN broadcast configuration.
Proven experience architecting real-time communications protocol stacks with deterministic timing requirements.
Experience with gNodeB integration in multi-operator or shared-RAN environments (MOCN, MORAN, etc.).
Strong knowledge of PLMN operations, network slicing concepts, and multi-operator resource sharing.
Expertise with MPLS, segment routing, and transport-network engineering for RAN backhaul.
Demonstrated experience working in lab environments, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, physical interface modeling, and test automation.
Proven track record of building engineering teams from the ground up, including defining team structure, hiring plans, and development frameworks.
Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, with measurable outcomes in promotions, skill development, and retention.
Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with O-RAN architectures, F1/E1 interfaces, or distributed RAN deployments.
Familiarity with SDN controllers, network orchestration, or cloud-native 5G Core implementations.
Background in C/C++, Rust, or real-time embedded systems.
Experience with network emulation tools, traffic generators, or protocol analyzers in a lab setting.
Knowledge of security requirements for multi-operator deployments, including authentication and isolation mechanisms.
Experience with satellite communications systems, non-terrestrial networks (NTN), or LEO constellation architectures.
Familiarity with Amazon's internal tools and processes (e.g., hiring loops, promotion processes, performance management).
Experience developing engineers across multiple job families (software, systems, test) simultaneously.
Track record of creating technical training programs or engineering development curricula.
Experience managing distributed or remote engineering teams across multiple time zones.
